title: Im pissed with the Indie communities
author: Zestyclose_Pick_8543
selftext: all the communities I posted about games are so toxic, why this happens? no one gives any feedback or say anything about the game itself just say it’s slop and other toxic comments, i’m making a game and people keep saying it’s AI slop without even playing it, why communities here are so toxic?

comments.author: ScallionZestyclose16
comments.body: Post your game and we’ll see if it’s slop or if some effort has been put into it :)

replies.author: Zestyclose_Pick_8543
replies.body: I posted it on some testing communities and got pretty good feedbacks, but game dev communities are just toxic

replies.author: Zestyclose_Pick_8543
replies.body: Im not even using AI for arts and visual stuff, just for coding

replies.author: Zestyclose_Pick_8543
replies.body: and about sharing my game, I have a page on itch.io but it’s pretty outdated, I will make a page on Steam soon

replies.author: Onye_Nacho
replies.body:
Honestly, why bother with Steam mate? Time has proven numerously that its useless to waste $100 of your money on a terrible RNG that is also riddled with far more toxic technophobes crying about "AI slop".

You'd be far better off just sticking to Itch and updating the page to the latest progress. At least for me, there is far less Neo-Luddite hate traffic to ever experience over there, and none that cannot be easily resolved with a report and block (or even reporting them to the admin on Discord or email too if necessary).

We have more than enough Steam games that never see any audience, purchases nor downloads. At least if it happens on Itch, you'd waste none of your money - only time loss shall be your sole penalty (unless you spent extra on other matters).

replies.author: mallcopsarebastards
replies.body: This is not a helpful response because OP is absolutely right. It does not matter a single bit how much effort you put into it, if AI is anywhere near it you're going to get dogpiled on for that alone.

replies.author: Zestyclose_Pick_8543
replies.body: exactly

replies.author: Kindly_Life_947
replies.body: yes and if you show them a game that is obviously using ai but doesn't have disclosure they will deny it to the absolute end. In their mind its flat earth AI slop cannot be good

comments.author: Mediocre_File3614
comments.body: Here’s a thought, maybe people don’t want Gen AI in their games. Nothing toxic, just the overall majority telling it how it is. ;)

replies.author: Impressive_Award_679
replies.body: "The majority"???? You mean those 8% minority that would not buy a ai generated game as u can finally see in statistics and surveys? How the hell do people like you think that this is the "majority"? XD The majority does not care about Gen Ai. But reddit is just a place where many failed artists are at home. But overall reddit isnt the majority. The majority are gamers. Not reddit users.

replies.author: mallcopsarebastards
replies.body: not a majority by a long shot. There's a loud fringe of weirdo's who care about this stuff. And they're all going to be pretty lost when, within the next year, every single game studio apart from a few very small indie holdouts will be using agentic tools for game dev.

replies.author: AltruisticNostalgia
replies.body: Don't understand why Antis come here and say meaningless stuff like this. It's cool if you don't like ai. I really don't care. It's still going into a majority of video games now and in the future. AAAs, AAs, indies, solos you name it. So you just going to stop gaming when ai use in games reaches to 95 to 98%?

comments.author: VisibleBoard8186
comments.body: Those are the ones who are not developing any meaningful games. A real developer has a constant voice in the back of his mind saying "what if my game won't be received well and gets negative comments". So they tend to be kind to people or leave without saying anything.

replies.author: Onye_Nacho
replies.body: Chances are those 'game devs' are not even truly devs to begin with. They're probably just wearing the title for show and attention. There's been a lot of that lately in this decade. It IS cool and popular to be a game dev now after all. Its no longer a 'lame' or 'taboo' title ripe enough to incur harassment like a "kick-me" sign or something.

replies.author: VisibleBoard8186
replies.body: absolutely right, also most people prefer to whine instead of hard work, because it is the easier path.

comments.author: emperormarkus
comments.body:
I agree - too many people want to be purists. I think so long as you are transparent  you should get a fair review.

I think there is a time and a place for those who are real, full time programmers and coders. The rest of us are part-time dabblers. There should still be a place for us.

replies.author: SolrayCultist
replies.body: Not everyone has a fat stack of cash to use on commissions or hiring programmers. And there might even be trust issues bringing strangers from the internet into your project. IMO.

replies.author: Onye_Nacho
replies.body: Yes. I still have trust problems with these other 'indie devs' - especially NOW since this decade began. At first it was the cancel-culture vultures. Now its the Neo-Luddites. Its toxin like this that made me a solo dev in the first place.

replies.author: Onye_Nacho
replies.body:
Transparency won't do anything at all to protect you from Neo-Luddism. In fact, it is not even necessary at all. Silence is golden and it is your best friend. What tools you use to make your game is honestly no one's damn business.

Besides, in this decade? \[\*sigh\*\] No way we can ever expect fairness to happen anymore...

comments.author: hwantasticgames
comments.body: Where is the testing community? I hope get more feedback!

replies.author: Zestyclose_Pick_8543
replies.body: it’s r/playtesters and some other more, I posted it in a lot of communities

replies.author: Zestyclose_Pick_8543
replies.body: like a month ago

comments.author: Bapstien
comments.body:
You're getting tons of useful feedback on your boxing management game ?

The only bad reviews you get are "looks like slop to me" because the entire UI is a default genAI output, the pissfilter is over the whole screen

replies.author: Zestyclose_Pick_8543
replies.body: im not saying about just my game, but I see a lot of games getting AI slop comments and the people don’t even see the game. About the UIs, I updated them. I made them better using Figma and not genAI, for the assets, i’m making them in Aseprite and getting a lot of stuff done, the only thing i’m using genAI is to code

replies.author: Bapstien
replies.body: You dont need to see much of it to know if its slop or not, if the dev shares a thumbnail or a screenshot full of genAI you can almost be sure the rest of the game is like that too, if no efforts were put in the content used to advertise thr rest of the product is probably not gonna be better

replies.author: Onye_Nacho
replies.body: That is an extremist fallacy. An AIG thumbnail definitely does not signify the game is 'slop'. Its a preview image that just summarizes your game's promotional content. The game itself can still be very fun to play once you try it. Conversely, there are plenty of human-made slop games and plenty of them even had fantastically crafted thumbnails in their promo art that turn out to also be exaggerative or misleading from the actual game experience. GAI does not change this.

comments.author: Morph_Games
comments.body:
Imagine walking into an a gathering of painters who all hand-paint their art on canvas. They've spent years honing their skills, and their works take many many hours to paint. You hold up a printed poster that you bought at the store and say "look what I made!" 

Your poster could be 10x more beautiful, but in their eyes you did not make it, and it is not art in the same way their paintings are.

Sure, human effort and design can be poured into AI works, but it becomes hard to distinguish who the artist is -- you or the machine.

replies.author: Zestyclose_Pick_8543
replies.body:
yeah, that is true, but even if you are just using AI to help with coding?

i’m using it just to help with coding, the visual assets I make them myself

replies.author: Morph_Games
replies.body:
Some devs see coding as a skilled profession, or even an art too. Saying "you made" a game, if really Claude was the lead developer, can upset game devs. 

I think indie gamedevs value effort, and the trouble is there's a huge range of human effort that can go into these games. Since it is hard to tell, people are suspicious.

replies.author: Onye_Nacho
replies.body:
I mean honestly what does it even matter? Its one thing if Claude 'programmed' the OP's game, but if he still made the game art, than he still co-developed the game. That game is still partially human-made or rather AI-assisted.

That is the problem with the Neo-Luddites - even you even use a single line of voice from a FOSS GAI tool like Applio, they'll still screech in malice as if you've murdered someone. This is Salem Trials-style insanity we're dealing with here. How can any human being survive in such a hostile environment? When will this evil tide just end already?

replies.author: DomiGamingOfficial
replies.body: It's not hard to distinguish. AI struggles to produce anything good on its own. If I went with AI suggestions my game wouldn't even make sense.

replies.author: Kindly_Life_947
replies.body: That is the beaty of technology. You don't need expensive artist, photographer or doctor to produce or fix things. Its all affordable to the regular person. Thats what they hate. They lose their power because some thech bro advanced society

comments.author: Old_Swan8945
comments.body: It's ironic how many downvotes this post and OP are getting in the comments, because this is exactly OP's point: that these Reddit communities Can be  toxic. It feels like the people who are downvoting that message might be part of the toxicity.

replies.author: Zestyclose_Pick_8543
replies.body: yeah, in the game dev communities people don’t judge about the quality of your game, if you say you used AI or try to defend it, people will just hate you and your game

replies.author: Onye_Nacho
replies.body:
This is why creativity is down the shitter. Society has turned extremely toxic in this evil decade. Not even just regarding GAI. Albeit GAI is the where the worst of these scum are showing their true colors.

As long as their zealous evil and abuse continues to exist, there will never be any such ground for creativity nor a safe community anymore - not even for the traditional artists. Art may as well be dead far as I am concerned.

Until these game devs learn to respect others on our creative rights and decisions for literally OUR OWN (usually free) indie games. I refuse to buy another new game from another game dev ever again, I don't care whether they are a 'small indie solo dev'. They don't deserve anyone's money or time behaving so toxically like this.

Starve them.
